label: Leicester
header:
# Leicester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Leicester's five selectboard members as Thomas Barker, Diane Benware, Brad Lawes, Diane Randall, and John Rouse

Town of Leicester, official results of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting (signed by Town Clerk Julie Delphia; declared elected under 17 V.S.A. section 2682(f)): Diane Randall was elected to the three-year seat and John Rouse to the two-year seat
Town of Leicester (official website, leicestervt.org), Selectboard page: Diane Benware (Chair, term to March 2028), Tom Barker (2027), Brad Lawes (2027), Diane Randall (2029), and John Rouse (2028)

Town of Leicester, official results of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting (signed by Town Clerk Julie Delphia; declared elected under 17 V.S.A. section 2682(f)): Julie Delphia was elected Town Clerk to a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Julie Delphia as Leicester's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Julie Delphia as Leicester's town clerk contact

Town of Leicester, official results of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting (signed by Town Clerk Julie Delphia; declared elected under 17 V.S.A. section 2682(f)): Julie Delphia was elected Town Treasurer to a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Julie Delphia as Leicester's treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Julie Delphia as Leicester's town treasurer contact
Town of Leicester, official results of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting (signed by Town Clerk Julie Delphia; declared elected under 17 V.S.A. section 2682(f)): Richard Reed was elected Moderator

Town of Leicester, official results of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting (signed by Town Clerk Julie Delphia; declared elected under 17 V.S.A. section 2682(f)): Lyndsay Davignon was elected Auditor to a three-year term

Town of Leicester (official website, leicestervt.org), Town Officials pages and the 2025 Town Report 'Leicester Town Officials' table: Auditors Lyndsay D'Avignon (recorded with the apostrophe, as the town styles her name in its 2026 Town Plan), Deb Miner (term to March 2027), and Donna Pidgeon (to March 2028), on staggered three-year terms

Town of Leicester, official results of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting (signed by Town Clerk Julie Delphia; declared elected under 17 V.S.A. section 2682(f)): Dianne Harvey was elected Delinquent Tax Collector
Town of Leicester (official website, leicestervt.org), Town Officials pages: Dianne Harvey is the current Delinquent Tax Collector (Elizabeth Ripley held the office before 2026)
Town of Leicester (official website, leicestervt.org), Town Officials pages and the 2025 Town Report's appointed-officials table: Jeff McDonough is First Constable, appointed by the Selectboard
Town of Leicester (official website, leicestervt.org), Town Officials pages and the 2025 Town Report's appointed-officials table: Mike Rakowitz is Second Constable, appointed by the Selectboard

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names five justices of the peace for Leicester: Diane Benware, Tom Barker, Cheryl Morrison, Greg Bernhardt, and Hilary Hatch
Town of Leicester (official website, leicestervt.org), Justices of the Peace page and the 2025 Town Report table name the same five
